title: observability: token-level metrics + tracing + logging dashboards and alert tuning
author: Aditi Rao
description: Motivation: Improve runtime-level observability for token/KV metrics, tracing, and structured logging to surface cost/latency regressions and to reduce pager noise. This PR adds new Grafana dashboards, refines tracing spans for request->serving runtime interactions, adds structured audit fields to runtime logs, and adjusts alert thresholds tuned to token-level cost/latency breakdowns. Work items: - Token-level cost/latency breakdown panels for per-model and per-route views - KV cache hit/miss metrics and percentiles surfaced at token granularity - Tracing: additional spans for scheduler/batcher handoff and kernel selection decisions - Structured logging: include request_id, model_version, routing_decision, and applied_quantization_profile - Alert tuning: reduce noisy paging by moving some alerts to warning queues and adding 1h burn rate checks - Backfill dashboard panels for Dedicated and Private deployments Implementation notes: metrics exported from runtime (/*/metrics) use new metric names prefixed with redwood_token_; tracing instrumentation uses W3C trace context and adds attributes for kv_hit, batch_size, and chosen_kernel; logs follow JSON schema v2. TODO/Follow-ups: - Add automated alpha test to validate token-level metric correctness against synthetic workload - Document dashboard panels in redwood-docs with examples and runbook entries
commits: Add token-level metrics exporter and naming conventions
Instrument scheduler and batcher for tracing spans
Add KV cache hit/miss metrics and percentiles
Structured JSON logging updates and schema v2
Grafana dashboard JSON and alert rule adjustments
Update observability README and runbook links
review_comments: Liam Chen: Can we avoid emitting token-level metrics for every single request in high-throughput paths? Suggest sampling or summarization.
Aditi Rao: Added a sampling config (default: 1 in 10) with an opt-in per-route override; dashboard panels compute per-token rates using counter deltas so sampled data is extrapolated.
Sofia Patel: Alert thresholds look aggressive for Dedicated clusters - we're seeing false positives during daily backup windows.
Aditi Rao: Tuned Dedicated alert thresholds and added a 1h burn-rate check plus a suppression window for scheduled backup windows (configurable via infra/alerts/schedule_overrides).
Ethan Wu: Tests are failing on the e2e tracing suite intermittently - appears to be a timing issue in test harness.
Aditi Rao: Increased timeout in tests and added a deterministic trace sampling seed for CI; reran CI and verified stability.
release_notes: Add token-level cost/latency dashboards (Grafana) and tracing/logging instrumentation; tune alerts to reduce noise. Backwards-compatible metric name migration included.
notes: This PR is part of the broader observability initiative to reduce MTTR for cost/latency regressions. Dashboards added for both hosted and dedicated deployments. Ops runbook updated in docs/observability/token_metrics.md
